tools.name: create_data_asset
tools.description: Create a new Data Asset instance of a specific class (e.g. UPrimaryDataAsset, UDataAsset subclass, or a custom Blueprint data asset class). Useful for structural game data like item properties, character stats, or ability definitions.

asset_path.description: Full content path for the new Data Asset (e.g. '/Game/Data/DA_IceSword'). Alternatively specify package_path and asset_name.

package_path.description: Package folder path for the new Data Asset (e.g. '/Game/Data')

asset_name.description: Asset name for the new Data Asset (e.g. 'DA_IceSword')

class_name.description: Class name or path of the Data Asset subclass (e.g. 'UMyItemData' or '/Game/Blueprints/BP_ItemData.BP_ItemData_C'). Alias: data_asset_class.

tools.name: set_data_asset_properties
tools.description: Set property values on an existing Data Asset via reflection. Property values can be strings, numbers, booleans, arrays, or JSON objects representing nested C++ structs.

asset_path.description: Content path of the target Data Asset (e.g. '/Game/Data/DA_IceSword')

properties.description: Key-value pairs of property names and their values (primitives, arrays, or nested struct objects).

tools.name: set_uobject_properties
tools.description: Set reflection property values on any loaded UObject or DataAsset asset in the Content Browser (including nested struct properties, arrays, booleans, and numbers).

asset_path.description: Content path of the target UObject / DataAsset (e.g. '/Game/Data/DA_IceSword')

properties.description: Key-value pairs of exact property names and their values (primitives, arrays, or nested struct objects).

tools.name: add_instanced_subobject
tools.description: Instantiate an inline UObject subobject (EditInlineNew / Instanced), configure its properties, and append it to an array property or set it on an object property of a target UObject or DataAsset.

parent_asset_path.description: Content path of the parent DataAsset or UObject (e.g. '/Game/Data/Upgrades/DA_Bio_Hull'). Alias: asset_path.

array_property_name.description: Name of the TArray or UObject property on the parent asset (e.g. 'UpgradeSpecifications'). Alias: property_name.

subobject_class.description: Class name of the subobject to instantiate (e.g. 'NumericalUnitUpgrade' or 'UGunUpgradeSpecification'). Alias: class_name.

properties.description: Key-value pairs of initial properties to set on the created subobject.

tools.name: get_data_asset_info
tools.description: Inspect and retrieve the current properties, types, and values of a Data Asset as JSON. Use this to understand the structure of a class instance before editing properties.

asset_path.description: Content path of the Data Asset to inspect

tools.name: save_asset
tools.description: Explicitly save an asset package to disk (e.g. saving modified materials, textures, Niagara systems, or data assets). Silently saves headless without modal prompts.

asset_path.description: Full path of the asset or package to save (e.g. '/Game/VFX/NS_Tau' or '/Game/Materials/M_Base').
